Alma is identified as the speaker in Alma 9:7 and continues speaking through 9:12–13. Calling him unnamed and prohibiting his identification contradicts the supplied verses.

Alma 9:34 continues the preceding encounter in Ammonihah. Although verse 34 does not repeat the location or identify the listeners, the preceding verses identify them as the people of Ammonihah; the fields calling both unspecified overlook that continuity.
